name: DarkSide-20k
summary: DarkSide-20k is a liquid-argon dark-matter experiment under construction at Gran Sasso with a dedicated supernova-neutrino programme. Its low-threshold ionization channel can detect a burst through coherent neutrino-nucleus scattering.
detection_principle: The dual-phase argon time projection chamber measures scintillation and extracted ionization. The low-threshold supernova forecast uses coherent nuclear recoils for an all-flavour burst measurement. The 2026 trigger study also considers charged-current argon reactions; they are a separate interaction channel.

status.label: Under construction
status.evidence: The June 2026 supernova-trigger contribution describes simulation-based development. The published Galactic-supernova reach is a forecast, not a detected burst.
